scope: Read-only Today inbox in the existing commerce-admin application. No messages, assignments, completed-work writes, new data permissions, live prices/campaigns, order repair, deployment or production access.
navigation: One canonical Today entry replaces the existing role-home slot in the scoped sidebar and command navigation. Sidebar stays at at most nine entries. /home remains an existing overview action and post-login landing. The protected welcome route retains its original legacy navigation.
pageAccess: The /today UI route inherits existing /home role eligibility. Each reader retains its existing backend role guard and authenticated server scope; caller role/user/scope parameters never select wider API data.

roleReaders.data: Original role-authorized summary. Only positive supported exception/awaiting-payment counts become queue-review signals. /today preserves each metric's scope and time definition; awaiting_payment is all-time, not due-today evidence.
Pending ERP change queues, with returned SKU evidence and source-reported queue count. Five records are sampled for evidence; no approval/rejection is performed.

roleReaders.api: Read-only GET /cs-admin/sample-requests?status=pending through the existing POST /api/josh/admin-call relay with method=GET
roleReaders.data: Returned pending requests only; identical duplicates collapse by request ID. Conflicting copies or invalid identities fail the source. No sample decision is submitted.
Authenticated owner's first page, up to twenty persisted drafts; existing receipt validation establishes saved state. Private draft ownership is not a persistent task assignment.

roleReaders.condition: A valid order UUID explicitly selected via /today?orderId=:uuid
roleReaders.data: One selected order's existing read-only findings, using the same vetted Thai/English finding labels as the canonical review page. No scanning of other orders, no repair, no retries or owner assignment. Other roles do not call or link these private review/draft APIs.
An authorized queue aggregate is unavailable. Explain the gap and link only existing authorized catalog and brand actions; those links are not counted as work.

taskLinks.scope: Summary signal; individual records are not inferred.
Existing report definition includes missing/nonpositive values; not verified live stock.
Original authorized all-time order scope; no invented deadline filter.
Existing separate review/decision page; navigation does not approve.

filters.q: Search the already returned evidence; no additional source reads or scope expansion.
filters.limit: 6 by default, bounded to 24; this is a returned-item display limit, not total workload.
filters.orderId: Admin-only selected-order context. A valid query on another role does not cause a private read or expose private links.
filters.history: Filters are URL-backed and reloadable; selection changes preserve back/forward. Text search replaces its history entry. Invalid filters block readers and offer clear/retry.

evidenceRules: Sort observed findings, then recorded pending queues, then evidence gaps. This is a review order without fabricated urgency, SLA breaches or due dates.

Positive summary counts are queue signals, not individually assigned tasks. Zero produces no signal; unknown is never zero. Missing required role metrics, wrong role/scope, malformed counts and business-failed envelopes fail validation.

Actual source read times are labeled as capture times. Imported/created timestamps are not used as proof of live source freshness. Freshness is unknown except a supported snapshot_stale finding, which means the backend review age policy was exceeded.

Missing assignment evidence stays explicitly unknown. Private drafts identify this account as owner without implying task assignment. Unassigned is a distinct supported filter state; no current reader fabricates it from a missing field.

Deduplicate the same stable entity/intent; retain differently scoped tasks. Conflicting copies are withheld or fail a source. All task URLs must be safe internal paths and role-allowed canonical destinations.

Independent read failures retain usable sources and expose retry. A stalled source attempt is bounded to fifteen seconds; late results do not replace a failed attempt. This transport timeout never determines business urgency. Empty/partial results never certify the whole app or all workflows as clear. Completed badges or assignments are not persisted by this page.
Shared labeled inputs/selects, skeletons, visible sanitized errors, live status, focusable links and scoped fluid styling support keyboard/mobile work. No global CSS/font or welcome-page changes.

checkpoint.scope: Exact union of accepted Commerce, BA foundation and proposal/order UI source/test/doc manifests. Excludes runtime artifacts, credentials and unrelated user work. Local commit only; no push.

verification.browserMode: Built app with strict synthetic read fixtures; native role-summary/order-review/promotion arithmetic builders. No real database persistence, production authentication, external requests or screenshots in this Today harness.
verification.existingGuardTests: Existing native Nest HTTP role-home and admin-only promotion/order guards rerun separately; API/backend code is unchanged.
verification.BAFoundation: Preserved by source hashes; no app/event/live integration.

remaining: No authoritative unified assignment or due-date contract. Unknown assignment/freshness remains visible; no persistent inbox actions are supported.
CS sees returned sample requests rather than an aggregate service-workload total. Graphic queue aggregates remain unavailable. Sales summary does not provide individual due-today tasks.
The inbox is a bounded read of existing sources, not a complete workload registry. Missing work cannot establish no work, and summary signals require inspection in their canonical feature.

Today does not change the previously documented promotion cost/stock/capacity/freshness gaps or order milestone gaps. MER comparison/ACL, pack-and-price, profit, sales/readiness/OCR and BA live integration remain queued. No further slice starts automatically.
